changes.text: TacWAM Wet-Lab Tasks: glove-teleoperated lab-bench tasks on a UFACTORY xArm6 with a BrainCo Revo2 right hand wearing a Tujian EI-G012 tactile glove (880 taxels, 15 pads), static Orbbec RGB-D and RealSense D405 wrist cameras; 177 counted demonstrations in three folders plus uncounted sorting, whiteboard and dual-arm tube-pour folders; Hugging Face gate with manual approval, CC BY-NC 4.0, no paper.

VTAO-BiManip: masked visual-tactile-action pretraining on 216 human bimanual bottle-cap unscrewing trajectories (two 20-sensor touch gloves, HoloLens 2, mocap) guiding curriculum RL for dual Shadow Hands (63% seen, 51% unseen bottles in simulation) and run on dual LEAP hands with tactile sensors; no code statement.
TachinGlove: linked to TacWAM Wet-Lab Tasks, whose card names a Tujian EI-G012 glove (15 pads, 880 taxels) on the robot hand.

RSS Dual-Arm Tactile: the same account's tacwam-wetlab-tasks repository has dual-arm tube-pour folders dated 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-22, matching this release's two batches; noted as the probable source of the copied batch, files not opened.

3dtacdex: license changed from not stated to MIT (Hugging Face card and LICENSE file, release 1.0.0 dated 2026-10-28); the card now describes the release as an Open-X-Tactile format submission with no official acceptance claimed. Data archives are unchanged (four Zarr ZIPs, 47,124 frames).

PULSE: card v1.2.1 names the authors (Wolin Liang et al., South China University of Technology), the venue (NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track, spotlight) and a permanent DOI (10.57967/hf/11314); scene-camera and eye-tracking overlay videos are listed for 312 recordings (311 files of each, about 63 GB), 454 human-reviewed S9 primitive segments were added, and the benchmark code repository velvet-pine-22/PULSE-code (MIT) now holds files. License stays CC BY-NC 4.0 plus use restrictions.

TactileLab In-Hand Rotation: 20 real rollouts (6,000 steps at 10 Hz, 10 objects) of sim-to-real rotation policies on a 4-finger LEAP-module hand with a TacTip optical sensor on each fingertip, raw 224x224 tactile images; public on Hugging Face (1.9 GB, license not stated).

ExoBridge: 1,215 paired demonstrations over 4 tasks with one bare hand on camera and the other in a DexUMI-family exoskeleton with 120-taxel arrays on thumb, index and middle fingertips; release of RGB, tactile and encoder data announced in the paper.

RSS Dual-Arm Tactile: 100 teleoperated tube-pour trajectories (plus 9 labelled failures) on two xArm6 arms with BrainCo Revo2 hands wearing Tujian (Tachin) tactile gloves, head and two wrist cameras; Hugging Face gate with manual approval, no paper.
ExoBridge: predicts fingertip contact, tactile intensity and exoskeleton motion from bare-hand video (any-contact AUROC 0.916, intensity r 0.790); evaluation code announced.

DexFLEX: contact-aware controller that reads FlexiTac 10x6 fingertip arrays on a LEAP hand and turns fingertip-motion drafts into joint targets, raising real teleoperation success from 29.2% to 78.3% (CoRL 2026); no code statement.

OccluDex: point-cloud and touch masked autoencoder pretrained on 1,690 WiseGlove human sequences (19 channels), used by a Shadow Hand policy with 19 FSRs; 85% and 70% zero-shot real success; no code statement.

HuTact: hand representation pretrained on 24 h of human hand-object data and 44 min of Revo2 play, read with Revo2 fingertip touch on a Unitree G1 (88.26% grasp Macro-F1 with 25% labels); no code statement.

CARD: retargets 744-taxel glove, mocap and video demonstrations into contact force targets and replays them on a Sharpa Wave hand with a fingertip-force tracker (4/30 to 25/30 replay success); code 'Link to come'.
Robot Synesthesia: in-hand rotation policy that turns 16 Allegro-hand FSR contacts into a tactile point cloud, trained in Isaac Gym and run on the real hand (ICRA 2024); code on GitHub (MIT).
TactoFind: touch-only localization, identification and grasping with GelSight 360 fingertips on a 3-finger D'Claw, 59.4% real-world retrieval (ICRA 2023); no code released.
TacTip (TacTip family): linked to the TactileLab In-Hand Rotation dataset (four TacTip fingertips on a LEAP-module hand).
TachinGlove: linked to RSS Dual-Arm Tactile, whose card names a Tujian (途见) tactile glove on each robot hand.

PULSE: scene-camera and eye-tracking MP4s (scene_cam.mp4, eye_tracking_overlay.mp4, 60-109 MB each) are now in the main Hugging Face repository under data/vN/sM/videos/ for the 3 recordings checked (v1/s1, v25/s2, v39/s4); used storage 78.8 GB, up from the 22.0 GB CSV-only tree on 2026-10-17. Video coverage of the other recordings was not counted.

EgoForce: about 2,000 h of bimanual human demonstrations (40k episodes, 1,000 tasks, 1,000 demonstrators) with TouchTronix gloves of 5 x 12 fingertip and 60 palm taxels per hand, calibrated to newtons, plus head stereo and two wrist cameras; data marked 'Coming Soon' on the project page.
FACT: force-action-track policy for two Sharpa Wave hands that predicts future fingertip force while refining actions, pretrained on EgoForce and 100 h of T-Rex; code announced.

PhysWord: NVIDIA policy that predicts atomic action words aligned with future visual and tactile latents, with one tactile token per Sharpa Wave hand, pretrained with T-Rex Sharpa data in a 7,400 h mix; code announced.

TransDex: visuo-tactile diffusion policy for a 16-DoF hand with PaXini 12x6 fingertip and 10x6 pad arrays, pretrained to reconstruct transparent-object point clouds, 83% average on 3 tasks (RA-L 2026); code on GitHub without a license.
AET-TacNet: autoencoder-transformer that infers hand touch from EMG and kinematics (NRMSE 0.032) on reaching, pouring, screwing and feeding (IEEE TII 2026); closed access, no code statement.
EgoTactile: Open-X-Tactile conversion HustleHard/EgoTactile-OXT (767 clips, 314,100 frames, 63 object zarr archives, 3.5 GB, CC BY-NC 4.0) linked as a derived release.
EgoExplorer: second repository InternRobotics/EgoExplorer-oxt (zarr, 25.5 GB, manual Hugging Face gate) linked as a derived release.

PX OmniSharing DB: AdvDex paper added to sources; it describes OmniShare (over 10k h, 168k trajectories, 721 objects, 14 views, Hall-effect tactile glove), which matches the sample's glove and cameras but states no release.
TactAlign: venue arXiv -> RSS 2026 (Robotics: Science and Systems XXII, DOI 10.15607/RSS.2026.XXII.006); the proceedings page lists no code or data link.
TactAlign: venue arXiv -> RSS 2026 (Robotics: Science and Systems XXII, DOI 10.15607/RSS.2026.XXII.006); code is still announced (project page 'Coming Soon', github.com/google/tactalign returns 404).

M2VTP BottleCap: human bottle-cap turning with a Zhejiang University glove of 20 binary touch signals and egocentric HoloLens 2 video (ICRA 2024); one OneDrive file linked from the pretraining README, files not opened, sequence count not published.

DexSkills: Allegro hand with 4 magnetic fingertip sensors teleoperated through an HGlove, 20 primitive skills and 20 long-horizon tasks released on GitHub as preprocessed haptic feature tensors (318 MB with checkpoints), no video, no license file.

M2VTP: masked visual-tactile transformer pretrained on egocentric video and 20 binary glove signals, then embedded in RL for a ShadowHand turning a bottle cap; code (MIT) on GitHub and pretrained models on OneDrive.
DexSkills: temporal autoencoder that labels 20 primitive skills from fingertip touch and proprioception on an Allegro hand, with one behaviour-cloned MLP per skill; code and 18 checkpoints on GitHub.

AdapTac-Dex: diffusion policy for a LEAP hand with 8 PaXini pads that predicts future net force to weight vision against touch (IROS 2025, 93% average success on 3 tasks); code on GitHub, only the tactile encoder checkpoint on Hugging Face.
RLHND: Cosmos 3 video backbone that estimates MANO hand pose and per-vertex contact and force from egocentric RGB, its tactile stream trained on 1,469 OpenTouch clips; code and weights announced.

SCS: LSTM that maps 8 fingertip touch channels from a glove worn in human grasps to grasp-stability states, driving a fuzzy grip-force controller on a robot hand with matching sensors (National Science Review 2025); data on request, no code statement.

Tactile-GAT: graph attention network that classifies 19 grasped objects from a 22-channel glove (16 FSR402 pressure, 6 flex) at 89.58% accuracy (Scientific Reports 2024); code on GitHub, data on request.
OSMO: published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (2026-05-11); venue updated from arXiv 2512.08920 and the DOI added to sources.

Ego2Contact: found unlinked Hugging Face repos under the user qqyang (datasets ego2contact-viz and ego2contact-sim-viz, model repos ego2contact-demo-videos, e2c-archive-ckpt and e2c-downstream-eval with .pth checkpoint files, no model card or license); the paper links no release, so code and weights stay not_released.

Spark-0: vision-tactile-language-action policy for two Wuji Hand 2 hands, pretrained on a 1.9k h mixture that includes 1,000 h of HumanTouch glove data; code (MIT) and a 10.2 GB checkpoint are on GitHub and Hugging Face.
Ego2Contact: predicts both hands' 21x21 tactile fields from egocentric RGB, trained on EgoTouch and adapted on EgoTactile and a BrainCo Revo 2 hand; no code or weights statement.
ViTaM: reconstructs held rigid and deformable objects from a 1,152-channel stretchable glove and a top-down RGB-D camera (Nature Communications 2024); code on GitHub, no checkpoint.
TouchScale: the publisher's FTP-1 zarr conversion of the 100 h release (TouchScale-OXT, 15,088 trajectories at 10 Hz, ~1.01 TB, Hugging Face gate with manual approval) is now linked from the entry.

TACROSS: the dataset is still unreleased (project page: 'Planned release, download link to follow'; software 'coming soon'); only hardware v1 (BOM, PCB Gerber files, pick-and-place coordinates, tacross_v1.zip, GitHub release of 2026-10-15) can be downloaded. Availability stays announced.
